title: optionsframe
summary: MSUI has a substantial options surface but in the 1.12 shape, not Benilla's: Escape opens a Game Menu modal (Program.Settings.cs, WowSkin-dressed) whose buttons lead to Video Options (rich live-apply page: quality presets, display/view/detail/streaming sliders and checks) and Interface Options (mouse/camera/controls page), plus Key Bindings and Macros windows; Escape-back and cancel-snapshot laws match the real client. Benilla instead built the era 1.15 single Options window (category tree, search, Audio/Graphics/Controls/Nameplates pages over a CVar store).

openItems.text: No Sound/Audio options page - the Game Menu's Sound Options button is permanently disabled ('no sound subsystem yet', a stale claim now that PlayUiSound exists) despite UI sounds being live
No nameplate options rows (Benilla's Nameplates page: show friendly/enemy plates etc.)
No per-page Defaults button (only whole-quality presets)
